title: There must be no user .rhosts files.
check_content:
The root role is required.

Check for the presence of .rhosts files.

# for dir in \
`logins -ox | awk -F: '($8 == "PS") { print $6 }'`; do
find ${dir}/.rhosts -type f -ls 2>/dev/null
done

If output is produced, this is a finding.
fixtext:
The root role is required.

Remove any .rhosts files found.

# rm [file name]
VulnDiscussion: Even though the .rhosts files are ineffective if support is disabled in /etc/pam.conf, they may have been brought over from other systems and could contain information useful to an attacker for those other systems.
